header.method: Claude curation pass over the constructicon-test copy of production (V2 migrations applied). For each open card:* decision: title, description, write-up body, hobbies and their active/inactive flag, first/last file dates and per-year counts, file counts by type, file provenance, a sample of file names with auto_captions and owner descriptions, tags, parent/children and links (via core.cards.explain_card plus direct SELECTs). Owner rulings from #428/#481 applied: one-object build = thing; project only for families, nested containers, design-only or system work; in_use = finished but still running or used; done = finished and resting; paused = set aside, likely back; collection = static collection or reference set. Recency alone is never treated as proof of use. Where evidence is thin, confidence is low and the least-claiming option is suggested.
header.keying: suggestions[<card slug>][<decision kind>] = {suggested, confidence, evidence}. Keyed by slug + kind, never by decision id (ids differ between test and prod).
